rules.name: High-impact automation without oversight
rules.reason: High-impact automated decisions without sufficient human oversight create significant governance and accountability risks, regardless of the aggregate score.

rules.name: High regulatory exposure combined with high decision impact
rules.reason: When a use case is both heavily regulated and has high real-world impact on individuals, understating the risk level could result in non-compliance or consumer harm.

rules.name: Discriminatory-impact potential without oversight
rules.reason: Significant potential for discriminatory outcomes combined with weak human oversight is a well-established driver of regulatory and reputational risk in financial services.

rules.name: Fully automated, maximum-impact decision
rules.reason: A fully automated system producing maximum-impact outcomes (e.g., denial of essential financial services) with essentially no human oversight represents the highest governance risk category.

rules.name: Highly sensitive data with weak security posture
rules.reason: Processing highly sensitive personal or financial data with inadequate security controls creates material breach and compliance exposure.

rules.name: Elevated model risk without adequate monitoring
rules.reason: Complex or drift-prone models deployed without production monitoring can silently degrade, causing undetected harm.

rules.name: Generative AI providing financial guidance with weak explainability
rules.reason: Generative AI outputs used for financial guidance carry hallucination risk; without adequate explainability and documentation, users and reviewers cannot assess reliability.
